title: Remove duplicate start call and unused declaration in File Locksmith IPC Writer

proposed_comments.body:
### Document the explicit writer initialization contract

**Severity:** `low`

Non-blocking API-documentation suggestion: construction no longer opens the stream, but the header does not state that callers must invoke `start()` and check its result before writing paths. Both existing construction sites already do so; this documents the changed lifecycle for future callers rather than alleging a current missing-start or HRESULT-handling defect.

```suggestion
        // Opens the output stream; check the result before calling add_path().
        HRESULT start();
```
proposed_comments.title: Document the explicit writer initialization contract

confidence.rationale: Exact current source supports this explicitly non-blocking clarification; existing guards and caller behavior are preserved.
